abstract: Asymptomatic intraplacental choriocarcinoma is a rare event with only a few case reports in the literature. The recognition of such a lesion on routine placental examination is important and prompts rapid clinical evaluation for identifying residual and/or metastatic disease followed by institution of chemotherapy. Failure to recognize such a lesion on gross inspection of the placenta can result in disseminated disease, which can be lethal. The following report describes the placental findings and clinical outcome in a recent case with a review of the relevant literature.
abstract_ja: 無症候性の胎盤内絨毛癌はまれな疾患で、報告例は少数である。定期的な胎盤検査でこの病変を認識することは重要であり、残存病変や転移病変の検索と化学療法の開始のための迅速な臨床評価を促す。肉眼的観察で病変を見逃すと、致死的となりうる播種性疾患に至る可能性がある。本報告では、最近の症例の胎盤所見と臨床転帰を記述し、関連文献をレビューする。
